verdicts.reason: Both banners drop the white heart shape and shrink the bed photo into a small thumbnail at the far left. The headline is tiny thin type that wraps onto three lines, which wastes the wide format, and both leave huge empty white areas. A puts the copy in the centre, which leaves the right third empty but keeps the text closer to the photo. B pushes the copy to the far right, which opens a large dead gap in the middle and makes the layout fall apart even more, so A is slightly less bad.
